parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const leadId=String(b.leadId??'').trim(); const dealId=String(b.dealId??'').trim(); const contractId=String(b.contractId??'').trim(); const settlementId=String(b.settlementId??'').trim(); const archiveEventId=String(b.archiveEventId??b.eventId??'').trim(); return [{json:{...b,leadId,dealId,contractId,settlementId,archiveEventId,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

nodes.name: Fetch Closed Deal Archive KPI Context

parameters.jsCode: const input=$('Normalize Closed Deal Archive Request').first().json; const ctx=$json.context??$json; const flags=[]; const state=String(ctx.dealState??ctx.lifecycleState??ctx.status??'').toLowerCase(); if(state!=='closed')flags.push('deal_not_closed'); if(ctx.settlementReconciled!==true&&ctx.settlementState!=='reconciled')flags.push('settlement_not_reconciled'); if(ctx.financialsReconciled!==true&&ctx.financialReconciliationState!=='reconciled')flags.push('financials_not_reconciled'); if(ctx.transactionCompleted!==true&&ctx.transactionCompletionState!=='completed')flags.push('transaction_not_completed'); if(ctx.archiveReady===false)flags.push('archive_not_ready'); const n=v=>Number.isFinite(Number(v))?Number(v):0; const grossRevenue=n(ctx.grossRevenue??ctx.assignmentFee); const purchasePrice=n(ctx.purchasePrice); const closingCosts=n(ctx.closingCosts); const otherCosts=n(ctx.otherCosts); const totalCosts=Math.round((purchasePrice+closingCosts+otherCosts)*100)/100; const netProfit=Math.round((grossRevenue-totalCosts)*100)/100; const investedCapital=Math.max(0,totalCosts); const roi=investedCapital>0?Math.round((netProfit/investedCapital)*10000)/100:0; const profitMargin=grossRevenue>0?Math.round((netProfit/grossRevenue)*10000)/100:0; const source=String(ctx.leadSource??ctx.source??'unknown').trim()||'unknown'; const channel=String(ctx.marketingChannel??ctx.channel??'unknown').trim()||'unknown'; const campaign=String(ctx.campaignId??ctx.campaign??'unknown').trim()||'unknown'; const closedAt=ctx.closedAt??ctx.closingCompletedAt??null; const contractAt=ctx.contractExecutedAt??ctx.contractSignedAt??null; const leadAt=ctx.leadCreatedAt??null; const days=(a,b)=>a&&b?Math.max(0,Math.round((new Date(b)-new Date(a))/86400000*100)/100):null; const leadToCloseDays=days(leadAt,closedAt); const contractToCloseDays=days(contractAt,closedAt); const transactionRecord={leadId:input.leadId,dealId:input.dealId,contractId:input.contractId,settlementId:input.settlementId,closedAt,grossRevenue,purchasePrice,closingCosts,otherCosts,totalCosts,netProfit,roi,profitMargin,source,channel,campaign,leadToCloseDays,contractToCloseDays}; const finalizable=flags.length===0; let decision='hold_archive',nextAction='resolve_archive_prerequisites',status='pending'; if(finalizable){decision='archive_and_update_kpis';nextAction='persist_permanent_transaction_record_and_refresh_portfolio_kpis';status='ready_to_archive';} const idempotencyKey='wf449:'+input.leadId+':'+input.dealId+':'+input.settlementId+':'+input.archiveEventId; return [{json:{...input,closedDealArchive:{status,decision,nextAction,transactionRecord,flags,archiveReady:finalizable,requiresHumanReview:!finalizable,confidenceScore:finalizable?99:25},idempotencyKey}}];

meta.notes: Creates a permanent closed transaction record and updates portfolio KPI/source attribution only after closed state, settlement reconciliation, financial reconciliation, transaction completion and archive readiness are verified. Production use requires canonical closed-deal accounting definitions, atomic KPI upsert semantics, verified InsulaCRM analytics schema and production API contracts.
